content: प्रो(प्रौ)ह {%a.%} .²1 A reasoner, disputant. .²2 Skilful, clever. .{@-हः@} .²1 Reasoning, logic. .²2 An elephantʼs foot or ankle; आकुञ्चितप्रोहनिरूपितक्रमं करेणुरारोहयते निषादिनम् <ls>Śi. 12. 5</ls>. .²3 A knot, joint. .²4 A part of the elephantʼs body especially between the shoulders; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 5. 5</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L. 5.">8</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L. 5.">12</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L.">6. 10</ls>.
